title: MatchRequest
description: POST body for creating a Match

accessorials.description: List of unique keys for required accessorials services

bill_of_lading_required.description:
DEPRECATED: For a pickup and dropoff photo of the bill of lading, set `signature_required` to `true` and `signature_type` to `photo` on the stop level. You will receive the pickup photo of the bill of lading at `match.signature_photo` and the delivery photo of the bill of lading at `match.stops[].signature_photo`.

Whether this Match requires a bill of lading photo on pickup

contract.description: If you have customized agreed-upon pricing with FRAYT, you will need to setup a corresponding contract identifier provided to you by the FRAYT team. Pricing defaults to our standard rates with the identifier in place.

dropoff_at.description: Scheduled date & time the final stop is to be delivered by

identifier.description: Unique identifier from external system. This will be returned in all responses, including webhooks.

optimize.description: Set to true if you want stops to be reordered in the most optimal route

origin_address.description: The pickup point for this Match

origin_photo_required.description: Whether this Match requires a photo of the origin address

parking_spot_required.description: Whether the driver should provide their parking spot ID

pickup_notes.description: Instructions for Driver when picking up

platform.description: The platform on which this match is being created

po.description: PO or Job Number for this Match

preferred_driver_email.description: The email of your preferred driver. The email of your preferred driver. Setting either the preferred_driver_email or preferred_driver_id fields will cause the match to be created as a preferred driver match. If a matching driver is not found then the preferred driver match will be created but without a preferred driver and a match update request will need to be made to attach a preferred driver.

preferred_driver_id.description: The id of your preferred driver. The email of your preferred driver. Setting either the preferred_driver_email or preferred_driver_id fields will cause the match to be created as a preferred driver match. If a matching driver is not found then the preferred driver match will be created but without a preferred driver and a match update request will need to be made to attach a preferred driver.

route_identifier.description: If this is a recurring route please provide your identifier to this field.

schedule_id.description: Unique identifier for the schedule this recurring Match belongs to

self_sender.description: When set to `true`, `sender` will be ignored

sender.description: The senders contact information, if different than the shippers

service_level.description: Set `1` for dash or `2` for same day

shipper_email.description:
Email of shipper this Match should be created under. If omitted, the system will:
1. Use your company's configured default shipper (if set and approved)
2. Fall back to the first approved shipper from your company's locations (if no default shipper configured)
3. Return an error if the default shipper is configured but not approved, or if no approved shippers are available

unload_method.description: Service type for box trucks. This is required when the vehicle class is box truck

vehicle_class.description:
You can especify the vehicle class and type for this match. It can be either a number or a string (see the documentation below)

List of available vehicle classes and types:
  • car
  • midsize
  • cargo_van
    • transit
    • standard
    • sprinter
  • pickup_truck
    • 4ft
    • 5ft
    • 6ft
    • 8ft
  • box_truck

NOTE: This can be left empty only if auto selection is enabled on your account. Reach out to the FRAYT team for more details

oneOf.description:
A combination of vehicle type key and vehicle class key can be used to select a specific vehicle type.

For example, to select a sprinter van, the value would be `cargo_van.sprinter` You can also specify only the type, in which case the smallest vehicle class for that type will be selected.
Set `1` for car, `2` for midsize, `3` for cargo van, and `4` for box truck, and `5` for pickup truck.

Accessorial.description: An add-on service for a shipment
Accessorial.title: Accessorial

name.description: The name of this address. This could be a store name, a park, or any other name

neighborhood.description: The general neighborhood the address is located in

name.description: Contact's first name and last name

notify.description: Set to `false` if the contact should not receive SMS and email notifications regarding the status of this shipment

phone_number.description: Contact's phone number in the general international format for telephone numbers (E.164)

Label.description: A label containing a format and a value used for generating a barcode or QR code.
Label.title: Label

NewMatchStopItem.description: An Item to be delivered to a stop

barcode.description: Value of barcode to be scanned for this item

barcode_delivery_required.description: Barcode reading is required for this item on delivery

barcode_pickup_required.description: Barcode reading is required for this item on pickup

container_barcode.description: Value of barcode for the container this item is in

declared_value.description: Declared value of the item being shipped in US cents (¢)

height.description: Individual height of each piece in inches

length.description: Individual length of each piece in inches

pieces.description: Number of items that match these dimensions

type.description: Type of item. When at least one item is a pallet, `needs_pallet_jack` will be an avaialable add-on.

volume.description: Individual volume of each piece in cubic inches (in³). If left empty, it will be calculated automatically based off of other dimensions

weight.description: Individual weight of each piece in pounds

width.description: Individual width of each piece in inches

cargo_location_required.description: Whether a cargo location is required for this stop

delivery_notes.description: Notes for the driver regarding delivery

destination_address.description: The dropoff point for this Stop

destination_photo_required.description: Whether a POD photo is required

dropoff_by.description: The latest the driver should arrive at this Stop

has_load_fee.description: Set to `true` if the driver will be required to unload the items

id_verified_at.description: Time the recipient's ID was verified

identifier.description: Unique identifier from external system. This will be returned in all responses, including webhooks.

self_recipient.description: When set to `true`, `recipient_name`, `recipient_phone`, and `recipient_email` will be ignored

signature_instructions.description: Required for photo signatures. Instructions for the driver to sign

signature_required.description: When set to `true`, Drivers will require requesting the customer's signature at delivery time.

tip_price.description: Additional tip for the driver in US cents (¢)
